scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,worker "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev:worker -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: eslint server web e2e playwright.config.ts scripts/s5-quality.mjs
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
scripts.format: prettier --write server/src server/tests web/src web/tests docs/api
scripts.test:quality: npm run build -w server && node scripts/s5-quality.mjs
